title: Add provider-neutral, read-only work-item contracts for GitHub Issues and Azure DevOps Boards. Reuse source-control provider kinds and pull-request actor/label primitives; define scoped references, normalized list/detail rows, provider summaries, bounded search/cursor inputs, partial per-project errors, and typed unavailable/operation errors. Add an optional environment capability but no RPC, provider implementation, credentials, UI, mutations, comments, or account mirroring in this slice.
